Name: NETWORK_MSG_PARAM_ST
Description: Multiplayer notification messages. The row ID is the message the game shows; each column holds the Network Message text used for one multiplayer role or state. A missing row falls back to row 999.

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Lower values win. A message is dropped while one with a lower value is showing or queued; a message with a lower value than the queued ones clears the queue. Retail uses 0–3.

Fields.Name: Force Play
Fields.Description: If set, the message is queued ahead of waiting messages of the same priority that don't have this set.
Padding.
